subject: Compliance intake: SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ — timeline & POC
messages:

To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tim Cho <tim.cho@equinoxhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Compliance intake: SOC 2, SIG v3, CAIQ — initial ask

Hi Ava,

Following up from our procurement intake — Equinox Health is lining up evidence for an audit window the week of 2026-08-15. Can Redwood confirm the following:

- Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report we can reference?
- Can you provide a SIG v3 matrix export and an attestation for CAIQ questions (preferably CSV/Excel)?
- Who is the technical POC for evidence (log retention, snapshot extraction, KMS usage)?
- Timeline: wed need sample artifacts (logs, config snapshots, control narratives) by 2026-07-25 to complete our audit runbook.

Attached is our questionnaire for reference (Equinox_SecurityQuestionnaire_v5.xlsx).

Thanks,
Sara Gold
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
Equinox Health
(sara.gold@equinoxhealth.com)

Hi Sara / Tim,

Thanks for the note and the questionnaire — we can support the items you listed. Quick answers up front:

- SOC 2 Type II: yes, we have a current SOC 2 Type II report (2025-11 coverage). We'll provide the redacted PDF and a control narrative summary.
- SIG v3 / CAIQ: we can export our SIG matrix and CAIQ mapping; format options: CSV or Excel.

To make sure were efficient, could we do a 30-min intake call early this week to confirm scope (prod only vs prod+staging), which controls youd like sampled, and any evidence format preferences? Proposed slots: Mon 6/29 09:00-10:00 PT or 11:00-12:00 PT.

Ive attached our initial-evidence-map-template.xlsx — if you can populate which controls you want sampled, that will let us route owners quickly.

Owners well loop in once scope is confirmed: Ben Carter (control/artifact collection) and Markus Klein (logging/snapshots).

Best,
Ava Chen
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com

--- Attachment: initial-evidence-map-template.xlsx (columns: control_id, artifact_example, owner, earliest_sample_date)

- Log retention: we retain auth and infra logs for 90 days by default and can produce compressed extracts; for deeper retention well need to prepare a snapshot and extraction run (estimate 2 business days).
- Snapshots: we have a runbook (k8s-snapshot-runbook.pdf) that documents how we pull configuration snapshots and redaction steps.
- KMS evidence: we can provide key rotation metadata and KMS policy exports (redacted).

Ive started an evidence map in Drive so Ben and I can drop links to artifacts as theyre generated: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-id/evidence-mapping
